summary: Bare sync is bounded to boards and pins (dependents follow only those parents), and every v5 list endpoint paginates with the bookmark cursor for sync and --all.
reason: The generator's default sync fanned out across 36 resources, and it does not recognize Pinterest's bookmark cursor, so sync and --all silently stopped after one page (boards 250 of 271, pins 241 of ~22.7k).
validated_outcome: Live read-only sync: 4 resources, 271 boards, 22,694 pins, 24,333 board pins, 0 pagination warnings; boards list --all returned 271. Unit tests cover cursor detection and termination.
